programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Suzanne Eaton, a renowned American scientist, vanished while jogging on the Greek island of Crete. The investigation into her murder uncovered a killer hiding in plain sight. A solved true crime case you won't forget.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Devastating Murder of Suzanne Eaton // Murdered While on a Run

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Apartment That Keeps a Secret: What Happened to Anne Manchester?
programme.desc: On July 8, 1980, Andrew and Joyce Manchester returned from vacation to discover their 26-year-old daughter Anne had been missing for 10 days. She vanished without a trace and was never seen again.
programme.sub-title: The Apartment That Keeps a Secret: What Happened to Anne Manchester?

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A woman stalks and kills her estranged husband's new girlfriend in broad daylight while witnesses watch. She tried to cover it up, but the evidence was overwhelming. A solved true crime case that is vicious, obsessive, and heartbreakingly avoidable.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: Jealous Wife Kills Her Husband's New GF: The Tragic Case of Michelle Boat & Tracy Mondabough

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In November 1993, 19-year-old college student Wanda Musk was abducted at knifepoint from her gas station job in Flint, Michigan, and beaten to death. DNA from a prisoner law finally solved the case in 2013.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In January 2018, 19-year-old gay college student Blaze Bernstein was lured to a California park by former classmate Samuel Woodward, who stabbed him 28 times. Woodward was convicted of hate crime murder in 2024.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A 14-year-old vanishes on her walk home from school. Nine months later, she shows up alive and names her kidnapper. A solved true crime case that is harrowing, suspenseful, and an extraordinary story of a young girl's survival.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: Teen TRICKED Her Kidnapper and ESCAPED Captivity! The Incredible Survival of Abby Hernandez

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 2016, 27-year-old Jessie Bardwell was murdered by her boyfriend Jason Lowe in Texas. He stored her body in his car for days while sexting other women. He was convicted and sentenced to 50 years in prison.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Sydney Loofe went on a Tinder date and never came home. The investigation uncovered a calculated murder planned by two predators. A solved true crime case that will stay with you.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A doctor is gunned down on the Ohio Turnpike in what looks like a random robbery. His grieving wife told a convincing story until investigators proved she ordered the hit. A solved true crime case that is brutal, calculated, and deeply personal.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Case of Dr. Gulam Moonda // MURDER FOR HIRE PLOT

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: When Mengqi Ji vanished, her husband claimed she walked out on him. But cell phone data, muddy boots, and a juniper tree in a state park told a very different story. A solved true crime case about control, lies, and justice.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Tragic Case of Mengqi Ji

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Alice Ruggles was stalked and murdered by her obsessive ex-boyfriend after the system failed to protect her. Her family now fights to make sure it doesn't happen again. A solved true crime case everyone needs to hear.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Horrific Murder of Alice Ruggles

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1999, 27-year-old Michelle Despinasse was shot dead in her Nanuet, NY home. Her answering machine captured her final moments, her voice pleading "Ken, stop", and became key evidence that convicted her ex-boyfriend.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In December 2019, 30-year-old Nadine Lott was brutally beaten by her ex-partner Daniel Murtagh in her Arklow, Ireland apartment. A neighbor witnessed him attacking her "like a wild animal," growling with rage. She died days later.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A 16-year-old calls 911 claiming an intruder killed her mom and her mom's boyfriend. But bloody footprints and security footage told a very different story. A true crime case built on lies that unraveled fast.
programme.sub-title: Teen Thought Dramatic 911 Call Could Fool Cops... But She Forgot One Thing

programme.title: Gabulosis: Florida’s Oldest Missing Child Case That Still Has No Answers: The Puzzling Case of "Jon Jon" Hagans

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook

programme.title: Et Ton Cash
programme.desc: Regnestykker, hængelåse og koder alt sammen noget der skaber forvirring og holdkaptajnen skubber hurtigt ansvaret fra sig og giver andre deltagere skylden.

programme.title: Et Ton Cash
programme.desc: Opsatte på ikke at tabe flere penge, er alle klar på at yde deres bedste. Der venter en stor overraskelse og for nogen af deltagerne bliver det skæbnesvangert at det ikke rigtig kører for dem.

programme.title: Et Ton Cash
programme.desc: Selv de mindste udfordringer kan virke som store forhindringer. En middag på Egeskov Slot kan ikke dæmpe uenighederne og midt i det hele dukker to nye deltagere op.

programme.title: Et Ton Cash
programme.desc: På Langelands fortet Behrad truet. En stor del af gruppen vil gerne af med ham. Men lige som holdet tror de kan sende ham i duel ved fælles hjælp, viser der sig en uventet mulighed.

programme.title: Et Ton Cash
programme.desc: Endnu engang bliver holdets samarbejde sat på prøve og der bliver holdt skarpt øje med om Behrad svigter holdet. Men dagens etape løber i bogstaveligste forstand af sporet og det bliver dyrt.

programme.title: Et Ton Cash
programme.desc: På den hidtil korteste etape på kun 128 m, viser udfordringerne sig at være langt større end ventet. En deltager melder sig helt ud af etapen og en anden ryger direkte videre til finaleprogrammet.

programme.title: Et Ton Cash
programme.desc: Sidste stop før finalen i København. I grusgraven ved Roskilde ryger to deltagere ud efter en benhård kamp, mens alliancer, bitterhed og følelser afgør, hvem der når hele vejen.

programme.title: Et Ton Cash
programme.desc: Finalen i Et ton cash er nået. Fire deltagere kæmper sig gennem Københavns morgentrafik med alle pengene på slæb, men kun tre når den afgørende finale på Nationalmuseet.

programme.title: Et Ton Cash
programme.desc: I første afsnit et ton cash, går det hurtigt op for deltagerne, hvor krævende det er at flytte et helt ton mønter, gennem Råbjerg Miles sandede bakker. Samarbejde og sammenhold er der ikke meget af.

programme.title: Et Ton Cash
programme.desc: Med den dyrt købte erfaring fortsætter turen mod København igennem Rebild Bakker. Mange kroner fattigere har de 14 deltagere virkelig brug for en holdkaptajn, der kan få alle pengene med i mål.

programme.title: Et Ton Cash
programme.desc: Den nyankomne deltager er blevet en del af holdet og er holdkaptajn på 3.etape igennem Mønsted Kalkgruber. Men den nye deltager er ikke just vellidt på holdet.

programme.desc: Jadzia Dax must choose between her feelings and the rules of Trill society when she is reunited with the wife of one of Dax's previous hosts.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Stjerneskib Nede
programme.desc: A fierce battle with the Jem'Hadar leaves the Defiant trapped in a planet's volatile atmosphere.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Små grønne mænd
programme.desc: A mishap sends Quark, Rom, and Nog back in time to Earth of 1947 in Roswell, New Mexico, where military forces mistake them for alien invaders.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Kahless sværd
programme.desc: Kor, a revered Klingon warrior, sets out with Worf and Dax in search of a mythical, ancient artifact they believe has the power to unite the Klingon Empire.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Vores mand Bashir
programme.desc: Posing as a 1960's secret agent in a malfunctioning holosuite program, Bashir is all that stands between his trapped fellow officers and certain death.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Hjemmefronten
programme.desc: Evidence that Changelings are targeting Earth sends Sisko back to his home planet, where he and Odo must prevent--or prepare for--war with the Dominion.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Paradisets fald
programme.desc: Preparing Earth for war with the Dominion, Sisko and Odo discover evidence of a Starfleet plot to seize control of the planet from the Federation.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Krydsild
programme.desc: Odo's hidden feelings for Kira interfere with his duty to protect the Bajoran First Minister--who also happens to be attracted to her.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Retur til elegance
programme.desc: A demoted Dukat enlists Kira's aid in regaining his former status in the Cardassian Empire.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Sønner af Mogh

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Bar Sammenslutningen

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Under en rejse på vej til et møde med de fjendtlige romulanere finder besætningen et skib med tre nedfrosne amerikanere fra det 20. århundrede.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Mens besætningen gør klar til at transportere en dødelig virus til et laboratorium, annoncerer rådgiver Troi, at hun er gravid.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Besætningen tages som gidsler i et mystisk tomrum af et væsen, der vil observere alle de måder, mennesker kan dø på.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Data påtager sig rollen som Sherlock Holmes på holodækket for at opklare et mysterium, der truer dr. Pulaskis liv.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Mens Enterprises besætning er vært for en frafalden og vittig kaptajn, kæmper Data med at få en humoristisk sans.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: En krigsramt planets fremtid afhænger af en døv mægler, som mister evnen til at kommunikere.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Besætningen kæmper med en mystisk sygdom, som fremskynder ældningsprocessen og dræber mennesker af alderdom på få dage.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Rikers loyalitet bliver sat på prøve, da han sendes ud til et klingonsk fartøj, som planlægger at angribe Enterprise.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Da Data nægter at blive skilt ad i forskningsøjemed, bliver Picard sat til at forsvare hans rettigheder i en retssal.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Wesley finder kærligheden hos den smukke unge regent af Daled Four, hvis hemmelige kræfter kan ødelægge Enterprise og dets besætning.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Enterprises computersystem bliver invaderet af en mystisk virus, som programmerer skibet til at selvdestruere.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Landgangspatruljen finder et stykke metal fra De Forenede Staters luftvåben og bliver fanget i "Hotel Royale", en roman, der er vækket til live.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: U.S.S. Enterprise finder en rumfærge fra Føderationen med en kopi af kaptajn Picard fra seks timer ude i fremtiden.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Rikers far dukker op aftenen før, han skal ud at være kaptajn på et nyt stjerneskib.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Data prøver at redde en lille pige på en dødsdømt planet.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Mens Picard kæmper for sit liv på operationsbordet, bliver Geordi taget som gidsel af rumvæsener.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: En redningsmission af en forsvunden Jord-koloni fører til opdagelsen af en civilisation, der består af kloner.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Trois mor besøger Enterprise i en søgen efter den perfekte mage og sætter jagten ind på kaptajn Picard.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: En officiel mission bliver personlig, da Worfs gamle flamme bliver sendt til Enterprise for at mægle i en konflikt mellem klingonerne og Føderationen.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: From a visiting alien ship, a fibrous, web-like creature secures itself inside an Enterprise launch bay and ensnares several crewmen. Hoshi must work to learn the creature's bizarre language in order to save the trapped crewmen.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Archer must delay the crew's much-needed shore leave to transport a Vulcan Ambassador from her planet of Mazar to rendezvous with a Vulcan ship.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Archer and Trip aid a disabled vessel and, in gratitude for their assistance, the vessel's captain invites the two officers to dinner in his desert-landscape village on his nearby home planet.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Finally arriving at the paradise of planet Risa, the Enterprise crew is able to enjoy two days and nights of much needed shore leave.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: The temporal cold war heats us as Captain Archer is taken to the 31st century by the Sulibans.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: As Archer makes his way back from the 31st century to prevent the Sulibans destroying the Enterprise, his crew tries to fend off the violent machinations and interrogations of leader Silik and come up with their own plan to keep the ship safe.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: T'Pol relates a tale of the Vulcans real First Contact when she claims that a relative of hers crash-landed in Carbon Creek, Pennsylvania in 1957, mingled with the townsfolk, and rescued workers in a mining accident.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: When Enterprise is struck by a soon-to-detonate weapon and lodges in the ship's hull, Reed must deactivate it, but his subsequent injury and a group of encroaching Romulans bent on destruction force Archer think creatively to save the crew and ship.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: To facilitate a lengthy list of necessary repairs, the crew visits an alien station with a super-computer that can fix anything. But the automated station's demands for payment seem too good to be true...until Mayweather is discovered dead.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Archer spends a sleepless night tending to his quarantined beagle Porthos and figuring out how to apologize to the quirky, ritualistic Kreetassens he inadvertently offended on a recent visit.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Archer feels compelled to help a rustic alien colony that finds their rich resources constantly dwindling due to the Klingons' pillaging ways.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Assigned to track down a Vulcan fugitive she lost 17 years ago, T'Pol enlists Archer and Mayweather's help in retrieving him, but finding the criminal triggers mysterious, deadly memories she has trouble resolving.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: When Reed accidentally loses his communicator during a visit to a pre-Warp culture, he and Archer must retrieve it, but when they do, they are mistaken for spies and are faced with the threat of execution.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: On a "typical" day on Enterprise, the crew finds their routine tasks turn into uncharacteristically strange obsessions over trivial matters.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Following her first experience in the transporter, a series of eerie events leads Hoshi to question whether or not she is the same person she used to be.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Trip rescues an exotic alien woman from her kidnappers, but ends up on an unexpected romantic adventure.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: When a deadly radioactive storm threatens Enterprise, the entire crew must take refuge for eight days in a small maintenance shaft.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Trip is fired upon by a territorial alien and forced to land on the night side of a moon.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: T'Pol's standing on Enterprise is threatened when it is learned that she has contracted a deadly disease.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Kropsdele
programme.desc: Misdiagnosed with a terminal disease, Quark sells his body parts on the Ferengi market to pay off his debts, then finds himself unable to break the contract.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Undergangen forestående
programme.desc: Sisko, Odo, O'Brien, and Worf enter Klingon territory on a suicide mission to expose Gowron, the Klingon leader, as a Changeling.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Søger efter par'Mach de forkerte steder
programme.desc: Worf helps Quark woo a visiting Klingon woman, despite the fact that he himself is in love with her.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Ikke kampen for de Stærke
programme.desc: Trapped on a planet under Klingon attack, Jake Sisko panics in the heat of battle.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Prøvelser og tribble-problemer
programme.desc: Sisko travels back in time to a pivotal moment in the history of the original Starship Enterprise.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Skærsildens Skygge
programme.desc: While Worf and Garak are imprisoned in the Gamma Quadrant, Sisko learns of a Dominion invasion.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Af Helvedes Lys
programme.desc: Led by Gul Dukat, Cardassia joins the Dominion and prepares to take over the Alpha Quadrant.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Imperiets soldater
programme.desc: On a mission for the Klingon Empire, Worf realizes that his friend General Martok is no longer fit to lead.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Tidens Børn
programme.desc: 22. Children Of Time Sisko and the Defiant crew must choose between the lives they have always known and the lives of their own descendants.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Ærens flammehav
programme.desc: Sisko attempts to force his traitorous former officer to stop a final Maquis attack that could lead to the destruction of the Federation.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: I kortene
programme.desc: Jake and Nog risk an intergalactic incident in an innocent quest to lift Sisko's spirits.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Tid til at rejse sig
programme.desc: Sisko and his crew embark on a secret mission in a captured Jem'Hadar warship.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Cyrano Jones returns, along with new tribbles that can't multiply.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Animated Series
programme.desc: The Enterprise and a Klingon ship must join forces to escape from a pocket universe that has been trapping starships for centuries.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Melora
programme.desc: After failing in love with a woman whose species is unable to walk in "normal" gravity, Bashir develops a technology that could free her of her wheelchair forever.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Playing God
programme.desc: While hosting her first Trill initiate, Dax discovers a tiny, developing universe, which threatens to destroy the station as it expands.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Blood Oath
programme.desc: Dax risks her life and her future with Starfleet to fulfill a blood oath made with three aged Klingons.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Crossover
programme.desc: A mishap in the wormhole sends Kira and Bashir into an alternate universe where Bajor is a tyrannical power and humans are slaves.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Quarks hus
programme.desc: In order to boost his business and gain respect, Quark lies about killing a Klingon, then winds up forced to marry the dead man's widow.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Visionær
programme.desc: An accident causes O'Brien to jump into the near future, where he witnesses his own death . . . and worse.

programme.title: Asteroid
programme.desc: Sammen med sin kone og datter flytter en mand fra storbyen til sit drømmehus i udkanten af en lille by, fjern fra al kommunikation. Timingen kunne dog have været bedre, da det viser sig, at verden er ved at kollapse.

programme.title: Cube
programme.desc: Syv vildt fremmede med vidt forskellige personlighedskarakteristika placeres ufrivilligt i en uendelig labyrint med dødbringende fælder.

programme.title: The Wraith
programme.desc: Jake bliver dræbt af kvarterets bøller og vender tilbage som en mystisk figur (The Wraith) for at få hævn.

programme.title: The Final Cut
programme.desc: Robin Williams, Mira Sorvino og Jim Caviezel leverer dynamiske præstationer i denne fantastiske thriller om de mørke sider af futuristisk teknologi.

programme.title: Nemesis 2 - Nebula
programme.desc: En skrækslagen mor bringer sin lille datter, Alex, tilbage til vore tid for at undslippe de robotterne, der hersker i hendes tidsalder. Alex vokser op hos en krigerisk afrikansk stamme. 19 år senere opsporer robotterne Alex for at udslette hende.

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: Hugh Jackman og den Oscar® vindende Rachel Weiszspinder instruktøren Darren Aronofsky en tidløs fabel om en mands søgen efter Livets Træ.

programme.title: Barbarella

programme.title: Explorers
